name: @prodqc/confluence-mcp
description: GET-only MCP extras for Confluence Server: page-link graph, version list, instance check, and a small fallback when mcp-atlassian cannot run

scripts.deps:ext4: PROJECT_CACHE_DIR="$HOME/.cache/projects/confluence-mcp-$(pwd -P | sha1sum | cut -c1-8)" && mkdir -p "$PROJECT_CACHE_DIR" && cp package.json "$PROJECT_CACHE_DIR/package.json" && npm --prefix "$PROJECT_CACHE_DIR" install --cache "$PROJECT_CACHE_DIR/npm" --no-audit --no-fund && ln -sfn "$PROJECT_CACHE_DIR/node_modules" ./node_modules
